_note: Sneakers upgrades. Same format as v0.1 upgrades.json. Weak spot is copying, so Defense has strong anti-copy upgrades. hologram skips the sn_fakes event, ownfactory skips sn_factory, patent skips sn_copycat.

trees.name: Product
trees.blurb: Make the shoe better so more people want it.

trees.name: Channels
trees.blurb: Get the shoe on more feet and more screens.

trees.name: Defense
trees.blurb: Stop copies and keep your fans.

upgrades.name: Comfy Soles
upgrades.desc: Soft soles that feel like clouds. Every fan tells more friends.

upgrades.name: Bold Colours
upgrades.desc: Bright colours that pop in photos. Social media works better.

upgrades.name: Sport Line
upgrades.desc: Real running shoes. Sporty people who said no now say yes.

upgrades.name: Limited Drops
upgrades.desc: Only 1000 pairs, then gone. People queue for days. Big appeal and more Hype bubbles.

upgrades.name: Athlete Shoe
upgrades.desc: A famous athlete gets their own shoe. Hard markets open up.

upgrades.name: Sneaker Photos
upgrades.desc: Post cool shoe photos. Works best where people are online a lot.

upgrades.name: Shoe Stores
upgrades.desc: Get into shoe stores. Works best where there are many shops.

upgrades.name: Sneakerheads
upgrades.desc: Send free pairs to sneaker collectors online. More fans and more Hype bubbles.

upgrades.name: Web Shop
upgrades.desc: Ship shoes all over the world. Your brand jumps to new regions much faster.

upgrades.name: City Billboards
upgrades.desc: Giant ads in the biggest cities. Growth goes up everywhere, but it costs a lot every day.

upgrades.name: Hologram Tags
upgrades.desc: A shiny tag proves a pair is real. Fans trust you, and fake copies get caught.

upgrades.name: Own Factory
upgrades.desc: Make the shoes yourself. Daily costs go down, each pair earns more, and factory delays do not hurt you.

upgrades.name: Design Patent
upgrades.desc: Your shoe design is protected. The rival copies you more slowly.

upgrades.name: Sneaker Crew
upgrades.desc: Superfans collect Hype bubbles for you and stay loyal.

upgrades.name: Lawyers
upgrades.desc: Sue the copycat. Their copy loses 20% right now and goes slower after.
